svg.text: Three tiers of composition, and one deterministic walk. The model picks from menus and fills in blanks — it never writes a rung, a command, or a conclusion.
each built only out of the one below it
A named dependency ladder for one kind of object.
bgp_session — 5 rungs · interface — 1 rung · isis_adjacency — 2 rungs · ldp_session — 2 rungs
declared, not yet built: l3vpn_service · topology
A flow is data, not code. Adding one adds no new rule.
A named question with a fixed answer shape.
9 collection intents: facts · interfaces · bgp · bgp_vpnv4 · lldp · isis · ldp · ldp_discovery · sr
7 object lookups: route · bgp_neighbor · interface · logging · config_isis · config_interface · sr_policy_detail
Each maps to approved commands plus a parser. Nothing else.
Exact strings, frozen, matched by identity.
templates re-render every argument from a typed object
There is no run_command(). This is the floor everything stands on.
WHAT THE MODEL IS ALLOWED TO DO HERE
Select a flow. Fill in a device and a subject. That is the whole surface.
It cannot author a rung, invent a command, or decide what 'broken' means —
so growth is new items in a list, never new rules to reason about.
the symptom you were paged about
▼ broken → keep going (the cause may be deeper)
Is there a TCP session under it?
separates 'BGP is unhappy' from 'nothing is connected'
▼ broken → keep going (the cause may be deeper)
Is there a route to the peer address?
no route → the session cannot form, whatever BGP says
▼ broken → keep going (the cause may be deeper)
Does the far device have IGP adjacencies?
the walk crosses to the OTHER device here
▼ broken → keep going (the cause may be deeper)
Are the path's member links up?
ANY_HEALTHY over the member set — one live member is enough
THE FOUR RULES OF THE WALK
stop descending this branch — nothing below it is the cause
keep going. The FIRST broken rung is the symptom; the LOWEST is the fault
STOP and say so. A rung that could not be judged is never read as healthy
if nothing on the dependency path is broken, that IS the answer — faults
found elsewhere are recorded as observations, not promoted to a cause
Every verdict above is code comparing parsed fields. No scoring, no
thresholds a model can nudge, no place for a plausible answer to enter.
This is the whole thesis: make the answer a walk over declared data, and the model's job shrinks to navigation — which is why a 4-billion-parameter model on a laptop can drive it.
